purpose: Determine whether the misleadingly named BioASQ meshMajor field behaves like all assigned MeSH descriptors or only MajorTopicYN=Y headings in a deterministic sample of the registered 2013 corpus.

evidence_seen_before_freeze.bounded_result: The five public records contain 72 BioASQ assignments: 71 match maintained-current PubMed descriptors and 9 match maintained-current MajorTopicYN=Y headings.

strata.rationale: Older records are most exposed to maintained-current indexing drift.
Covers the era of the canonical Swanson development diagnostics without treating it as period-appropriate.
Separates late twentieth-century records from the post-2002 candidate window.
Contains the frozen 2006 publication cutoff used by one proposed post-2002 positive case.
Contains the frozen 2010 publication cutoff used by one proposed post-2002 positive case.
Directly audits the source-defined 2011 cutoff used by two proposed post-2002 positive cases.
Directly audits the source-defined 2012 cutoff used by one proposed post-2002 positive case.
Checks records nearest the declared 1 March 2013 indexing cutoff.

limitations: The strata are deliberately balanced around scientific cutoffs and are not weighted to estimate a corpus-wide population fraction.
PubMed EFetch exposes maintained-current records, not the MeSH assignments or major-topic flags frozen on 1 March 2013.
A passing result is bounded evidence about field semantics in 416 predeclared records; it is not proof of PMID-level corpus completeness or an original historical-baseline substitute.
This protocol cannot contribute metric-v3 readiness and no gap score, rank, bridge, or candidate formula may enter sampling or interpretation.
